name: CT90
description:
## Description

"CT series tall boy type speaker system.A 26cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.The frame of this unit is made of aluminum die-cast to improve the sound quality during large-amplitude reproduction. In addition, a corrugated damper with optimum compliance is used for the damper to greatly improve the linearity of cone amplitude.Aluminum with excellent heat radiation effect is used for the voice coil bobbin, and heat radiation holes are provided in the bobbin so that it can withstand temperature rise up to 250?.The cone paper uses a material with an excellent damping effect to eliminate split vibrations that cause colorization of the playback sound. In addition, input resistance and machining accuracy have been greatly improved by the adoption of the bobbin integrated type. In addition, a special dump structure has been adopted for the diaphragm, yoke, diaphragm and diffuser to eliminate harmful resonance of titanium.Parts with less error are used in the network section to achieve a more accurate crossover frequency. In addition, parts such as air core or ferrite core coil are laid out with space on the board to eliminate inter-part effects.6mm thick for the speaker terminal2Large terminals are used for speaker cables.The enclosure is made of 42mm thick high-density particleboards which are butt-plated on both sides to eliminate board deformation and the round corners are made of top-of-the-line wood.Felt is attached to the front baffle to improve sound quality by absorbing the sound reflected by the tweeter.There are 2types of exterior, mahogany and piano lacquer finish."

name: ERGO70
description:
## Description

"The ERGO series speaker system has been improved while inheriting the existing CT series.It has a 16cm cone woofer in the low range and a 16cm cone squaker in the middle range.A newly developed graphite-reinforced polypropylene cone is used for the diaphragm of these units.A 2.5cm hard-domed tweeter is installed in the high range.A manganese-aluminum diaphragm developed in the field of aerospace science is adopted for the diaphragm. Moreover, the diaphragm and bobbin are integrated to enhance the heat radiation effect and realize excellent transient characteristics as well as high input resistance.The network section is designed with an emphasis on phase characteristics, and group delay characteristics, in which the phase of a specific frequency is delayed, are greatly improved. In addition, the use of durable high-quality parts reduces the deterioration of sound quality caused by the network.The enclosure uses a bass reflex system.The inside consists of the upper part of the closed 2-way system and the lower part of the bass reflex system. By placing the tweeter between the skoker and woofer, it has a clearer and natural feeling of spread.The exterior features a felt-covered baffle plate and round corners to reduce unwanted sound radiation and enhance the interior.A large screw-type terminal is used for the input terminal to accommodate very thick cables.There are 2variations of finishing, mahogany and walnut."
